description: Self-contained Zoho CRM REST API workhorse. Real OAuth2 refresh-token grant (POST {accounts_host}/oauth/v2/token) -- Zoho refresh tokens never rotate and never expire on their own. Retry on 401 (token refresh) / 429 / 5xx. .get()/.post()/.patch() convenience methods plus .upsert() wrapping Zoho's native Upsert Records API (POST /{module}/upsert, duplicate_check_fields, 100 records/request).

outputs.description: ZohoCrmResource with .get()/.post()/.patch()/.upsert() methods. Consumed by zoho_crm_record_upsert (sink) and by custom Dagster asset code that needs arbitrary Zoho CRM REST calls.

resource_key.description: Resource key. Other components reference it via this name.
resource_key.label: Resource Key

client_id_env_var.description: Env var holding the Zoho OAuth Client ID.

client_secret_env_var.description: Env var holding the Zoho OAuth Client Secret.

refresh_token_env_var.description: Env var holding the long-lived OAuth refresh token.

accounts_domain.description: Zoho accounts data-center region: 'com' (US), 'eu', 'in', 'com.au', 'jp', 'com.cn', or 'ca' (mapped to accounts.zohocloud.ca).

api_domain.description: Override the Zoho API host. Leave unset to use the api_domain Zoho's OAuth token response returns for your data center.

max_retries.label: Max Retries
